metadata.description: Microsoft Sentinel scheduled analytics rules pack from sentinel-detections-au mapping ASD/ACSC advisories to MITRE ATT&CK and ISM controls.
Name of the Log Analytics workspace where Microsoft Sentinel is enabled.
Set true to enable rules immediately, or leave false to deploy disabled for initial review and tuning.

properties.displayName: Password-Protected Archive Staging for Data Exfiltration
properties.description: Detects creation of password-protected or split archives via 7-Zip, WinRAR or tar inside temporary or staging folders, a common pre-exfiltration step in state-linked intrusions. ISM controls: ISM-0580, ISM-1405. Advisories: acsc-2026-10-09-chinese-state-linked-automated-tools.
properties.query:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where FileName in~ ("7z.exe", "7za.exe", "rar.exe", "winrar.exe", "7z")
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any (" -p", " -hp", " -v")
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("\\temp\\", "\\programdata\\", "\\public\\", "/tmp/", "/dev/shm/")
| project Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, InitiatingProcessFileName, FileName, ProcessCommandLine, ReportId

properties.displayName: LSASS Memory Dump via Comsvcs or Native Dump Utilities
properties.description: Detects attempts to dump Local Security Authority Subsystem Service (LSASS) process memory using rundll32 with comsvcs.dll MiniDump or Sysinternals procdump. ISM controls: ISM-0580, ISM-1405, ISM-1657. Advisories: acsc-2026-10-09-chinese-state-linked-automated-tools.
properties.query:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where (FileName =~ "rundll32.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_all ("comsvcs", "minidump"))
    or (FileName in~ ("procdump.exe", "procdump64.exe") and ProcessCommandLine has_all ("-ma", "lsass"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, InitiatingProcessFileName, FileName, ProcessCommandLine, ReportId

properties.displayName: Microsoft Defender Antivirus Exclusion Added via Command Line
properties.description: Detects PowerShell Add-MpPreference commands or registry modifications adding exclusions to Microsoft Defender Antivirus, commonly performed by crypted malware loaders to evade scans. ISM controls: ISM-0580, ISM-0843, ISM-1405, ISM-1621. Advisories: acsc-2026-09-08-digital-camouflage-crypters-malware.
properties.query:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where FileName in~ ("powershell.exe", "pwsh.exe", "cmd.exe", "reg.exe")
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("Add-MpPreference", "Set-MpPreference", "Windows Defender\\Exclusions")
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("ExclusionPath", "ExclusionProcess", "ExclusionExtension", "DisableRealtimeMonitoring", "Exclusions\\Paths")
| project Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, InitiatingProcessFileName, FileName, ProcessCommandLine, ReportId

properties.displayName: Web Server Process Spawning Command Shell (Web Shell Follow-On)
properties.description: Detects web server or application gateway worker processes spawning command shells or reconnaissance binaries, indicative of web shell execution following exploitation of internet-facing applications or appliances. ISM controls: ISM-0580, ISM-1144, ISM-1405. Advisories: acsc-2026-10-01-citrix-netscaler-critical-vulnerabilities, acsc-2026-11-17-vulnerabilities-patch-protect-prevent.
properties.query:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("w3wp.exe", "httpd", "apache2", "nginx", "tomcat9.exe", "java.exe")
| where FileName in~ ("cmd.exe", "powershell.exe", "pwsh.exe", "sh", "bash", "whoami.exe", "whoami", "certutil.exe", "curl", "wget")
| project Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, InitiatingProcessFileName, FileName, ProcessCommandLine, ReportId

properties.displayName: Unexpected Internal Administrative Protocol Traffic From Edge or DMZ Hosts
properties.description: Detects outbound SMB, RDP or WinRM connections initiated from perimeter, gateway or DMZ named endpoints toward internal subnets, consistent with post-exploitation lateral movement after edge device compromise. ISM controls: ISM-0580, ISM-1144, ISM-1405, ISM-1690. Advisories: acsc-2026-10-23-fortinet-critical-vulnerabilities, acsc-2026-11-17-vulnerabilities-patch-protect-prevent.
properties.query:
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where DeviceName has_any ("dmz", "edge", "vpn", "gw", "proxy", "bastion")
| where RemotePort in (445, 3389, 5985, 5986)
| where RemoteIPType == "Private"
| where ActionType == "ConnectionSuccess"
| project Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, InitiatingProcessFileName, LocalIP, RemoteIP, RemotePort, ReportId

properties.displayName: Edge VPN Brute Force Followed by Successful Authentication
properties.description: Detects repeated authentication failures against Fortinet or Citrix perimeter gateways in CommonSecurityLog followed by a successful login from the same source IP address. ISM controls: ISM-0580, ISM-1405, ISM-1504, ISM-1690. Advisories: acsc-2026-10-23-fortinet-critical-vulnerabilities, acsc-2026-10-01-citrix-netscaler-critical-vulnerabilities.
properties.query:
CommonSecurityLog
| where DeviceVendor in~ ("Fortinet", "Citrix")
| where Activity has_any ("ssl-login", "vpn", "login", "authentication")
| summarize
    FailedAttempts = countif(DeviceAction has_any ("fail", "deny", "blocked", "ssl-login-fail")),
    SuccessAttempts = countif(DeviceAction has_any ("success", "allow", "tunnel-up", "ssl-login-ok")),
    Users = make_set(DestinationUserName, 10)
    by SourceIP, DeviceVendor
| where FailedAttempts >= 5 and SuccessAttempts >= 1
| extend DestinationUserName = tostring(Users[0])
| project SourceIP, DeviceVendor, FailedAttempts, SuccessAttempts, DestinationUserName

properties.displayName: High-Risk OAuth Permission Consent Granted in Microsoft Entra ID
properties.description: Detects consent grants assigning high-privilege Graph or mail/file read permissions to enterprise applications or AI integrations, which can expose sensitive data if abused. ISM controls: ISM-0580, ISM-1405, ISM-1504, ISM-1657. Advisories: acsc-2026-09-25-protect-organisations-ai-services.
properties.query:
AuditLogs
| where OperationName in ("Consent to application", "Add delegated permission grant", "Add app role assignment to service principal")
| where Result == "success"
| extend ModifiedProps = tostring(TargetResources)
| where ModifiedProps has_any ("Mail.Read", "Files.Read.All", "Sites.Read.All", "Directory.ReadWrite.All", "RoleManagement.ReadWrite.Directory")
| extend InitiatingUser = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName)
| extend TargetAppName = tostring(TargetResources[0].displayName)
| project TimeGenerated, OperationName, InitiatingUser, TargetAppName, ModifiedProps

properties.displayName: Credential Added to Microsoft Entra ID Application or Service Principal
properties.description: Detects addition of new secrets or certificates to Microsoft Entra ID applications or service principals, including identities used to access organisational AI services. ISM controls: ISM-0580, ISM-1405, ISM-1504, ISM-1657. Advisories: acsc-2026-09-25-protect-organisations-ai-services.
properties.query:
AuditLogs
| where OperationName has_any ("Update application - Certificates and secrets management", "Add service principal credentials", "Update service principal")
| where Result == "success"
| extend InitiatingUser = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName)
| extend TargetAppName = tostring(TargetResources[0].displayName)
| where isnotempty(TargetAppName)
| project TimeGenerated, OperationName, InitiatingUser, TargetAppName, Result

properties.displayName: Certutil Abuse for Remote File Download or Decoding
properties.description: Detects certutil.exe invoked with urlcache, split or decode flags to retrieve remote payloads or decode staged files, a living off the land technique detailed in ASD/ACSC joint guidance. ISM controls: ISM-0580, ISM-0843, ISM-1405, ISM-1621. Advisories: acsc-2024-02-07-identifying-and-mitigating-living-off-the-land-techniques.
properties.query:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where FileName =~ "certutil.exe"
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("-urlcache", "/urlcache", "-verifyctl", "/verifyctl", "-decode", "/decode", "-decodehex")
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("http://", "https://", "ftp://", ".exe", ".dll", ".ps1", ".bat", ".vbs")
| project Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, InitiatingProcessFileName, FileName, ProcessCommandLine, ReportId

properties.displayName: Encoded PowerShell Execution via Living off the Land
properties.description: Detects powershell.exe or pwsh.exe launched with encoded command flags, a common living off the land execution technique highlighted in ASD/ACSC joint guidance. ISM controls: ISM-1621, ISM-0580, ISM-1405. Advisories: acsc-2024-02-07-identifying-and-mitigating-living-off-the-land-techniques.
properties.query:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where FileName in~ ("powershell.exe", "pwsh.exe")
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("-enc ", "-encodedcommand ", " -e ", " -ec ")
| where not(InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("ccmexec.exe", "intunemanagementextension.exe"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, InitiatingProcessFileName, FileName, ProcessCommandLine, ReportId

properties.displayName: Netsh Portproxy Tunnel Configuration
properties.description: Detects netsh.exe creating IPv4/IPv6 portproxy forwarding rules to pivot traffic through compromised Windows hosts, a hallmark living off the land proxying technique noted in ASD/ACSC joint guidance. ISM controls: ISM-0580, ISM-1405, ISM-1621. Advisories: acsc-2024-02-07-identifying-and-mitigating-living-off-the-land-techniques.
properties.query:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where FileName =~ "netsh.exe"
| where ProcessCommandLine has_all ("interface", "portproxy", "add")
| project Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, InitiatingProcessFileName, FileName, ProcessCommandLine, ReportId

properties.displayName: Active Directory NTDS.dit Extraction via Ntdsutil IFM
properties.description: Detects ntdsutil.exe invoked with Install From Media (IFM) arguments to dump the Active Directory NTDS.dit database, a living off the land credential theft technique highlighted in ASD/ACSC guidance. ISM controls: ISM-0580, ISM-1405, ISM-1657. Advisories: acsc-2024-02-07-identifying-and-mitigating-living-off-the-land-techniques, acsc-2026-10-09-chinese-state-linked-automated-tools.
properties.query:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where FileName =~ "ntdsutil.exe"
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("ifm", "create full", "ac i ntds", "activate instance ntds")
| project Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, InitiatingProcessFileName, FileName, ProcessCommandLine, ReportId

properties.displayName: Suspicious Scheduled Task Creation Invoking Script Engine
properties.description: Detects schtasks.exe creating scheduled tasks that invoke scripting interpreters or binaries located in user-writable temporary directories for persistence. ISM controls: ISM-0580, ISM-0843, ISM-1405, ISM-1621. Advisories: acsc-2024-02-07-identifying-and-mitigating-living-off-the-land-techniques.
properties.query:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where FileName =~ "schtasks.exe"
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("/create", "-create")
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("powershell", "pwsh", "wscript", "cscript", "mshta", "cmd.exe", "\\temp\\", "\\public\\", "\\appdata\\")
| project Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, InitiatingProcessFileName, FileName, ProcessCommandLine, ReportId

properties.displayName: Volume Shadow Copy Deletion via Native Utilities
properties.description: Detects deletion of Windows Volume Shadow Copies via vssadmin, wmic or PowerShell to inhibit system recovery during ransomware or destructive post-exploitation activity. ISM controls: ISM-0580, ISM-1405, ISM-1511. Advisories: acsc-2024-02-07-identifying-and-mitigating-living-off-the-land-techniques, acsc-2026-09-08-digital-camouflage-crypters-malware.
properties.query:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where FileName in~ ("vssadmin.exe", "wmic.exe", "powershell.exe", "pwsh.exe")
| where (ProcessCommandLine has_all ("delete", "shadows"))
    or (ProcessCommandLine has_all ("shadowcopy", "delete"))
    or (ProcessCommandLine has_all ("Win32_ShadowCopy", "Delete"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, InitiatingProcessFileName, FileName, ProcessCommandLine, ReportId

properties.displayName: Remote Process Creation via WMIC
properties.description: Detects wmic.exe executing process call create against remote hosts (/node:), a living off the land lateral movement and execution technique covered in ASD/ACSC joint guidance. ISM controls: ISM-0580, ISM-1405, ISM-1621, ISM-1657. Advisories: acsc-2024-02-07-identifying-and-mitigating-living-off-the-land-techniques.
properties.query:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where FileName =~ "wmic.exe"
| where ProcessCommandLine has_all ("/node:", "process", "call", "create")
| project Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, InitiatingProcessFileName, FileName, ProcessCommandLine, ReportId

properties.displayName: Suspicious Exchange Online Inbox Forwarding or Hiding Rule Created
properties.description: Detects creation or modification of Exchange Online inbox rules that forward email externally or hide messages in RSS or Deleted Items folders following credential phishing. ISM controls: ISM-0580, ISM-1405, ISM-1504. Advisories: acsc-2026-09-08-russian-state-phishing-zimbra.
properties.query:
CloudAppEvents
| where ActionType in ("New-InboxRule", "Set-InboxRule", "Set-Mailbox")
| extend RuleData = tostring(RawEventData)
| where RuleData has_any ("ForwardTo", "ForwardAsAttachmentTo", "RedirectTo", "ForwardingSmtpAddress", "MarkAsRead", "MoveToFolder")
| where RuleData has_any ("ForwardTo", "ForwardAsAttachmentTo", "RedirectTo", "ForwardingSmtpAddress", "RSS Feeds", "Deleted Items", "Conversation History")
| project Timestamp, AccountObjectId, AccountDisplayName, ActionType, IPAddress, CountryCode, RuleData, ReportId

properties.displayName: High-Risk Cloud Sign-In Without Phishing-Resistant MFA
properties.description: Detects successful Microsoft Entra ID sign-ins flagged at medium or high risk where single-factor authentication succeeded or legacy authentication protocols were used, consistent with credential phishing or stolen session replay. ISM controls: ISM-0580, ISM-1405, ISM-1504, ISM-1657. Advisories: acsc-2026-09-08-russian-state-phishing-zimbra, acsc-2026-11-17-vulnerabilities-patch-protect-prevent.
properties.query:
SigninLogs
| where ResultType == "0"
| where RiskLevelDuringSignIn in~ ("medium", "high")
| where AuthenticationRequirement =~ "singleFactorAuthentication"
    or ClientAppUsed in~ ("IMAP4", "POP3", "SMTP", "Exchange ActiveSync", "Other clients")
| project TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, AppDisplayName, ClientAppUsed, RiskLevelDuringSignIn, AuthenticationRequirement

properties.displayName: Non-Browser Process Accessing Browser Credential Stores
properties.description: Detects scripting runtimes or untrusted binaries interacting with Chromium or Firefox credential and profile database files, consistent with stealer payloads used by WaterPlum. ISM controls: ISM-0580, ISM-1405, ISM-1657. Advisories: acsc-2026-09-22-north-korean-waterplum-contagious-interview.
properties.query:
DeviceFileEvents
| where FileName in~ ("Login Data", "Local State", "logins.json", "key4.db")
| where FolderPath has_any ("Chrome\\User Data", "Edge\\User Data", "Firefox\\Profiles", "Google/Chrome", "BraveSoftware")
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("node.exe", "node", "python.exe", "python3", "powershell.exe", "pwsh.exe", "cmd.exe")
| project Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, InitiatingProcessFileName, FolderPath, FileName, ReportId

properties.displayName: Suspicious Node.js or Python Developer Runtime Spawning Obfuscated Shell
properties.description: Detects Node.js, npm or Python developer runtimes executing remote download or encoded shell commands, matching WaterPlum (Contagious Interview) tradecraft targeting IT staff. ISM controls: ISM-0580, ISM-0843, ISM-1405, ISM-1621. Advisories: acsc-2026-09-22-north-korean-waterplum-contagious-interview.
properties.query:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("node.exe", "node", "npm", "npx", "python.exe", "python3")
| where FileName in~ ("powershell.exe", "pwsh.exe", "cmd.exe", "sh", "bash", "curl", "wget")
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("-enc", "base64", "eval(", "curl ", "wget ", "http://", "https://")
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("| sh", "| bash", "iex", "invoke-expression", "-enc", "base64")
| project Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, InitiatingProcessFileName, FileName, ProcessCommandLine, ReportId

properties.displayName: PHP Runtime Spawning Interactive Shell or Download Utility
properties.description: Detects PHP interpreter or PHP-FPM/CGI worker processes launching OS shells or network download utilities, indicating exploitation of critical PHP vulnerabilities. ISM controls: ISM-0580, ISM-1144, ISM-1405, ISM-1690. Advisories: acsc-2026-10-21-php-critical-vulnerabilities, acsc-2026-11-17-vulnerabilities-patch-protect-prevent.
properties.query:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where InitiatingProcessFileName has_any ("php", "php-cgi", "php-fpm")
| where FileName in~ ("sh", "bash", "dash", "cmd.exe", "powershell.exe", "curl", "wget", "python3", "perl")
| project Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, InitiatingProcessFileName, FileName, ProcessCommandLine, ReportId

properties.displayName: Suspicious PHP Web Shell Script Dropped into Webroot
properties.description: Detects creation or modification of PHP or executable script files inside standard webroot directories by web server or PHP processes. ISM controls: ISM-0580, ISM-1144, ISM-1405. Advisories: acsc-2026-10-21-php-critical-vulnerabilities.
properties.query:
DeviceFileEvents
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated", "FileModified")
| where FolderPath has_any ("/var/www/", "/srv/www/", "\\inetpub\\wwwroot\\", "/usr/share/nginx/html/")
| where FileName endswith ".php" or FileName endswith ".phtml" or FileName endswith ".phar"
| where InitiatingProcessFileName has_any ("php", "httpd", "apache2", "nginx", "w3wp.exe")
| project Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, InitiatingProcessFileName, FolderPath, FileName, SHA256, ReportId
